dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver/unrar:latest AS unrar

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver/baseimage-alpine:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG SABNZBD_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thespad"

# environment settings
ENV HOME="/config" \
  PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8

RUN \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apk add -U --update --no-cache --virtual=build-dependencies \
    autoconf \
    automake \
    build-base \
    libffi-dev \
    openssl-dev \
    python3-dev && \
  apk add  -U --update --no-cache \
    7zip \
    python3 && \
  echo "**** install sabnzbd ****" && \
  if [ -z ${SABNZBD_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    SABNZBD_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/sabnzbd/sabnzbd/releases \
    | jq -r 'first(.[]) | .tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  mkdir -p /app/sabnzbd && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/sabnzbd.tar.gz -L \
    "https://github.com/sabnzbd/sabnzbd/archive/${SABNZBD_VERSION}.tar.gz" && \
  tar xf \
    /tmp/sabnzbd.tar.gz -C \
    /app/sabnzbd --strip-components=1 && \
  cd /app/sabnzbd && \
  python3 -m venv /lsiopy && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir \
    pip \
    setuptools && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.24/ -r requirements.txt && \
  echo "**** build sab translations ****" && \
  python3 tools/make_mo.py && \
  echo "**** install par2cmdline-turbo from source ****" && \
  PAR2_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/animetosho/par2cmdline-turbo/releases/latest \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  mkdir /tmp/par2cmdline && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/par2cmdline.tar.gz -L \
    "https://github.com/animetosho/par2cmdline-turbo/archive/${PAR2_VERSION}.tar.gz" && \
  tar xf \
    /tmp/par2cmdline.tar.gz -C \
    /tmp/par2cmdline --strip-components=1 && \
  cd /tmp/par2cmdline && \
  ./automake.sh && \
  ./configure && \
  make && \
  make check && \
  make install && \
  echo "**** Patch Sab commit into version.py ****" && \
  SAB_COMMIT_SHA=$(curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/sabnzbd/sabnzbd/git/ref/tags/${SABNZBD_VERSION}" | jq -r '.object.sha') && \
  sed -i "s/__baseline__ .*/__baseline__ = \"${SAB_COMMIT_SHA}\"/" /app/sabnzbd/sabnzbd/version.py && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    $HOME/.cache \
    $HOME/.cargo

# add local files
COPY root/ /

# add unrar
COPY --from=unrar /usr/bin/unrar-alpine /usr/bin/unrar

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8080
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-sabnzbd-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    if grep -qe ' /downloads ' /proc/mounts; then
        lsiown abc:abc /downloads
    fi

    if grep -qe ' /incomplete-downloads ' /proc/mounts; then
        lsiown abc:abc /incomplete-downloads
    fi

    find /config -path /config/Downloads -prune -o -exec lsiown abc:abc {} +
fi

units.name: svc-sabnzbd
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

FAMILY=::

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    if ! test -f /proc/net/if_inet6; then
        FAMILY=0.0.0.0
        sed '/ip6-/d' /etc/hosts > /etc/hosts.new
        cat /etc/hosts.new > /etc/hosts
        rm /etc/hosts.new
    fi

    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 \
            s6-setuidgid abc python3 /app/sabnzbd/SABnzbd.py \
            --config-file /config --server "$FAMILY"
else
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 \
            python3 /app/sabnzbd/SABnzbd.py \
            --config-file /config --server "$FAMILY"
fi

notes.upstream:
Release Notes - SABnzbd 5.2.0 Beta 2
=========================================================

This is the second test release of version 5.2.0.
We are still working on several other features, but hope you will already enjoy
the current improvements and give us feedback!

## New features in 5.2.0

* Downloaded data will be written directly to disk (if your hardware supports it),
  which greatly reduces memory and CPU usage on systems with SSD's.
  Additionally, several other performance improvements were made.
* Search your Indexers and add downloads directly from within SABnzbd.
* Post-Processing, Pre-Queue and Notification Scripts no longer receive
  command-line arguments. Use the `SAB_*` environment variables instead.
  This prevents an attacker easy access to remote code execution.
* Download directories can no longer be inside the program directory.
  This is also to prevent an attacker easy access to remote code execution.
* Changed the internal webserver from CherryPy to Starlette.
* Overview of Active Sessions is available when username and password are enabled.
* Only allow proxied requests from hosts configured in `xff_trusted_hosts`.
* Removed the `scriptlog` link from the `script_log` history field.
* Remove unused fields `completeness`, `meta`, `series`, `id`, and
  `script_log` from `history`-API response.
* Cache `Public IPv4 address` for 10 minutes to prevent abuse.

## Bug fixes in 5.2.0

* Downloads with `Repair` priority would not always be at the top of the queue.
* Failure to read one RSS URL would stop the whole readout instead of continuing to the next.
* Prevent potential XSS in the History from malicious Script output (GHSA-rpwc-qfxm-7h2v)
  or malicious NNTP responses (GHSA-c5x2-896f-g5g8).
* Correct `articles_success` to `articles_failed` in Server statistics API-call.
* Stalled Unrar could freeze the post-processing queue.
* File handles could remain open after download completed.
* Downloads with missing articles and no PAR2 would not be marked as failed.
* macOS: Tray icon would not show on macOS 27.

## Upgrade notices

* You can directly upgrade from version 3.0.0 and newer.
* Upgrading from older versions will require performing a `Queue repair`.

## Code Signing Policy

Windows code signing is provided by SignPath.io using a SignPath Foundation certificate.

## About

SABnzbd is an open-source cross-platform binary newsreader.
It simplifies the process of downloading from Usenet dramatically, thanks to its web-based
user interface and advanced built-in post-processing options that automatically verify, repair,
extract and clean up posts downloaded from Usenet.
